objects.description: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used an information gathering module that will hide an AV software window from the victim.(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also been known to use `-WindowStyle Hidden` to conceal PowerShell windows.(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)
